verses.original: וַיָּשֶׂם֩ הַמֶּ֨לֶךְ אֲחָשֵׁרֹשׁ מַ֛ס עַל־ הָאָ֖רֶץ וְאִיֵּ֥י הַיָּֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·śem ham·me·leḵ ʾă·ḥå̄·šē·rōš mas ‘al- hā·’ā·reṣ wə·’î·yê hay·yām
verses.literal: Now King Xerxes imposed tribute throughout the land even to its farthest shores . . .
verses.literalPt: O rei Assuero impôs tributo à terra e às ilhas do mar.

verses.original: וְכָל־ מַעֲשֵׂ֤ה תָקְפּוֹ֙ וּגְב֣וּרָת֔וֹ וּפָרָשַׁת֙ גְּדֻלַּ֣ת מָרְדֳּכַ֔י אֲשֶׁ֥ר גִּדְּל֖וֹ הַמֶּ֑לֶךְ הֲלוֹא־ הֵ֣ם כְּתוּבִ֗ים עַל־ סֵ֙פֶר֙ דִּבְרֵ֣י הַיָּמִ֔ים לְמַלְכֵ֖י מָדַ֥י וּפָרָֽס׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵāl ma·‘ă·śêh ṯā·qə·pōw ū·ḡə·ḇū·rā·ṯōw ū·p̄ā·rā·šaṯ gə·ḏul·laṯ mā·rə·do·ḵay ’ă·šer gid·də·lōw ham·me·leḵ hă·lō·w- hêm kə·ṯū·ḇîm ‘al- sê·p̄er diḇ·rê hay·yā·mîm lə·mal·ḵê mā·ḏay ū·p̄ā·rās
verses.literal: And all of Mordecai’s powerful and magnificent accomplishments together with the full account of the greatness to which the king had raised him are they not written in the Book of the Chronicles . . . of the Kings of Media and Persia
verses.literalPt: Todos os atos do seu poder e do seu valor e a narrativa completa da grandeza de Mordecai com que o rei o engrandeceu não estão eles escritos nos livros das Crônicas dos Reis da Média e da Pérsia?

verses.original: כִּ֣י׀ מָרְדֳּכַ֣י הַיְּהוּדִ֗י מִשְׁנֶה֙ לַמֶּ֣לֶךְ אֲחַשְׁוֵר֔וֹשׁ וְגָדוֹל֙ לַיְּהוּדִ֔ים וְרָצ֖וּי לְרֹ֣ב אֶחָ֑יו דֹּרֵ֥שׁ טוֹב֙ לְעַמּ֔וֹ וְדֹבֵ֥ר שָׁל֖וֹם לְכָל־ זַרְעֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: kî mā·rə·do·ḵay hay·yə·hū·ḏî miš·neh lam·me·leḵ ’ă·ḥaš·wê·rō·wōš wə·ḡā·ḏō·wl lay·yə·hū·ḏîm wə·rā·ṣui lə·rōḇ ’e·ḥāw dō·rêš ṭō·wḇ lə·‘am·mōw wə·ḏō·ḇêr šā·lō·wm lə·ḵāl zar·‘ōw
verses.literal: For Mordecai the Jew was second only to King Xerxes preeminent among the Jews and highly favored by his many kinsmen seeking the good of his people and speaking peace to all his countrymen
verses.literalPt: Pois o judeu Mordecai foi o segundo depois do rei Assuero, e grande entre os judeus, e estimado pela multidão de seus irmãos, porque procurava o bem-estar do seu povo e cuidava da prosperidade de toda a sua raça.
